title: Edited script of Kodescripts to a gui
script:
local VLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vep1032/VepStuff/main/VL"))()

local s = VLib:Window("Edit of Kodescripts  script ", "Welcome!", "Pro")

local Main = s:Tab("Main")


Main:Button('Inf weeb case',function()
getgenv().CaseToOpen = "Weeb"
getgenv().caseopen = true
getgenv().cooldown = 0.1

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kodescripts/scripts/main/CaseOpener.lua"))()

end)
